LESSON: THE LORD’S SUPPER

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.2: The Lord’s Supper

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Lord’s Supper. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do Christians celebrate the Lord’s Table/Eucharist/Sacra ment/Holy Communion today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the events that took place during the Lord’s Supper
2. explain the significance of the Lord’s Supper to Christians today
3. identify the values required during the celebration of Lord’s Table/Eucharist today

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE LORD’S SUPPER
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The Lord’s Supper helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THE LORD’S SUPPER
Study The Lord’s Supper like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe the events that took place during the Lord’s Supper

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the events that took place during the Lord’s Supper. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the events that took place during the Lord’s Supper.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The Lord’s Supper” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the events that took place during the Lord’s Supper. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the significance of the Lord’s Supper to Christians today

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the significance of the Lord’s Supper to Christians today. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the significance of the Lord’s Supper to Christians today.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The Lord’s Supper in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the significance of the Lord’s Supper to Christians today. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Identify the values required during the celebration of Lord’s Table/Eucharist today

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the values required during the celebration of Lord’s Table/Eucharist today. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the values required during the celebration of Lord’s Table/Eucharist today.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the values required during the celebration of Lord’s Table/Eucharist today. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The Lord’s Supper is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The Lord’s Supper” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the events that took place during the Lord’s Supper)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The Lord’s Supper in your own words. (skill: explain the significance of the Lord’s Supper to Christians today)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: identify the values required during the celebration of Lord’s Table/Eucharist today)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The Lord’s Supper to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the events that took place during the Lord’s Supper.
3. Practise this skill: explain the significance of the Lord’s Supper to Christians today.
4. Practise this skill: identify the values required during the celebration of Lord’s Table/Eucharist today.
5. Make one local Kenya example of The Lord’s Supper from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The Lord’s Supper: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study The Lord’s Supper?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do Christians celebrate the Lord’s Table/Eucharist/Sacra ment/Holy Communion today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The Lord’s Supper means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the events that took place during the Lord’s Supper.
5. Be able to: explain the significance of the Lord’s Supper to Christians today.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
